content.text: The fcrepo-migration-validator  will need to be updated to take this situation into account.
can you also add a ticket for the migration validator?
I’ve updated the ticket description with the full stack trace and attached the offending FoxML

PR has had a few commits to add an integrastion test and further logic to test for ‘none’ digest. If someone could take a look to sanity check over the logic, it would be appreciated. I’m new to OCFL and hope that I’m not breaking anything in this fix
This could do with a second pair of eyes looking over it by someone more familiar with OCFL in case if pushes the issue down the road to the OCFL implementation some how
Currently the validation of inline datastreams throws an exception for UNREADABLE OBJECT

/etc/alternatives/java_sdk_18_openjdk/bin/java  -jar target/migration-utils-6.3.0-SNAPSHOT-driver.jar -t legacy -d ./datastre
ams  -a /tmp/FCREPO-3847-data -i /tmp/FCREPO-3847-working -o ./objects  --debug
INFO 12:01:45.138 (InternalIDResolver) Building an index of all the datastreams in "./datastreams"...

        at org.fcrepo.migration.Migrator.run(Migrator.java:186)

Caused by: java.lang.RuntimeException: MIGRATION_FAILURE: pid="llgc-id:1591190", message="java.security.NoSuchAlgorithmException: DISABLED MessageDigest not available"
        at org.fcrepo.migration.Migrator.run(Migrator.java:169)
        ... 9 more
Caused by: java.lang.IllegalArgumentException: java.security.NoSuchAlgorithmException: DISABLED MessageDigest not available
        at org.apache.commons.codec.digest.DigestUtils.getDigest(DigestUtils.java:135)
        at org.fcrepo.migration.foxml.FoxmlInputStreamFedoraObjectProcessor$Foxml11DatastreamVersion.validateInlineXml(FoxmlInputStreamFedoraObjectProcessor.java:478)
        at org.fcrepo.migration.foxml.FoxmlInputStreamFedoraObjectProcessor.processObject(FoxmlInputStreamFedoraObjectProcessor.java:196)
        at org.fcrepo.migration.Migrator.run(Migrator.java:161)
        ... 9 more
Caused by: java.security.NoSuchAlgorithmException: DISABLED MessageDigest not available
        at java.base/sun.security.jca.GetInstance.getInstance(GetInstance.java:159)
        at java.base/java.security.MessageDigest.getInstance(MessageDigest.java:185)

        ... 12 more
for the digetsType of “DISABLED“ would allow the code to progress. You can not validate the digest when there isn’t one to validate. As far as I can tell, it is a legitimate use-case.
